features.heading: What You Get
features.description: You decide where people go and what they can win, and you can see the results while the event is still on.

items.title: Guide Foot Traffic
items.description: You choose where the checkpoints go. Put them at sponsor booths or in the parts of the venue people usually skip, and players will walk there.

items.title: Reward Participation
items.description: Points come from playing, not from turning up. Players spend them in the event store on merch and sponsor giveaways.

items.title: Simple Setup
items.description: We place the NFC tags or QR codes wherever you want them. Players sign in once and are playing a few seconds later, without installing an app.

items.title: Live Data
items.description: A live dashboard shows which checkpoints get visits, which areas stay quiet and who your most active players are.

steps.title: Tap a Treasure
steps.description: Each treasure is an NFC tag hidden somewhere in the venue. Players tap it with their phone and get points straight away.

steps.title: Find the Rest on the Map
steps.description: The map shows the treasures a player has not found yet, so they know where to go next.

steps.title: Redeem at the Store
steps.description: Players spend their points at the event store on rewards, such as merch and sponsor giveaways.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: It can be ready in 48 hours. You tell us where the checkpoints go and what the rewards are, and we design and install the QR codes and NFC tags.

items.question: Do attendees need to download an app?
items.answer: No. The game runs in the phone browser. Players sign in with one tap and can start straight away.

items.question: Can we use our own branding?
items.answer: Yes. Pro and Enterprise include custom checkpoint designs and reward names of your choice. Enterprise can also be fully white-label.

items.question: What data do organizers get?
items.answer: Every package includes a live dashboard during the event, with checkpoint visits, engagement heatmaps and the leaderboard. Enterprise adds a post-event analytics report you can share with sponsors, and a dashboard that compares results across several events.
